About OpenAPIHub

OpenAPIHub is a free developer directory of public APIs. Each entry is sourced from the open-source public-apis dataset and enriched with HTTPS, auth, and CORS metadata so you can quickly decide whether an API fits your project.

How we make money

We monetize through display ads and affiliate links to hosting and developer-tool providers. Clicking an affiliate link may earn us a commission at no extra cost to you.
